name: 诊断2：js 与 locator 的差异

args.code: () => { const el1 = document.querySelector('#chat-textarea'); const el2 = document.querySelector('.chat-textarea'); const el3 = document.querySelector('[contenteditable]'); const fmt = e => e ? (e.tagName + '|' + (e.id||'-') + '|' + (e.className||'-').toString().slice(0,40) + '|ce=' + e.isContentEditable) : 'null'; return {byId: fmt(el1), byClass: fmt(el2), ce: fmt(el3)}; }
